Retsu Kaioh, reincarnated into another world, engages in epic battles against swords, magic, and even powerful creatures of this other world in order to "prove that Chinese martial arts are the strongest in this other world"—a one-of-a-kind isekai reincarnation action story!

(Source: YouTube description, translated)

216167.description:
Pokémon: Wild Card tells the exciting story of a Pokémon TCG player and his partner Mimikyu. When the time comes to put their cards on the table, will they have what it takes to achieve their goals?

(Source: The Pokémon Company)

title.romaji: Majime na Kimi ni Hamaru Karada THE ANIMATION
title.native: 真面目なキミにハマるカラダ THE ANIMATION

216171.description:
After entering college, Azusa Shirakawa was enjoying campus life, marking a fresh start from her high school days, when she had devoted herself entirely to judo. But a casual joke from her childhood friend, Sae, ignited a fire within her. “Having a friends-with-benefits relationship isn't so bad, you know?” She had brushed off those words as a joke, but—her “one-time fling” with Takuma, her serious and sincere childhood friend, awakened a desire within Azusa, and her body found itself unable to resist the pleasure. Contrary to her intentions, she found herself losing control time and time again. “I never thought the day would come when I'd be getting my body in shape not for judo competitions, but for sex...” She, who was supposed to be so strong-willed, finds herself “losing” to a man. He—serious yet lecherous—begins to “corrupt” her.

(Source: Pinkpineapple, translated)

title.romaji: Majime na Kimi ni Hamaru Karada

216175.description:
That summer, the girls met through table tennis. Now, that white light shines once more. The story of these table tennis girls is about to turn a new page.

(Source: Official Weibo Account)

216170.description:
Caught in an endlessly repeating August 31st, high schoolers Suzuki Takaya and Takagi Kana are the only ones who remember each loop. The likely cause? Suzuki’s unfinished summer mission to secure a girlfriend and lose his virginity—the ultimate teenage goal. A hilarious yet heartfelt time-loop comedy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.romaji: Lian Qi Shi Wan Nian Special: Yangji Tianxia
title.english: One Hundred Thousand Years of Qi Training: Yang Ascendant
title.native: 炼气十万年特别篇 阳极天下

216176.description:
At the dawn of creation, chaos invades the boundless world, quietly seeding a fragment of its power into every being born within it, waiting to harvest that power once it ripens. To stand against the chaos, Jue Tiantong takes on his first disciple, Xu Yin, a young man he pins his greatest hopes on. But Xu Yin betrays him. Millions of years later, Xu Yang leads the Tianlan Sect. When the Five Thrones revive Xu Yin from his long dormancy, he returns wielding a chaos power far more devastating than before. The war between yin and yang begins.

(Source: WeTV)

216312.description:
When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright. As it turns out, she likes Asahi Suzukaze, the president of the mysterious “Clinical Trials Club.” When he joins the club to learn more about Asahi, he discovers that she also has a crush on someone else! Could this chain of crushes get any more complicated…?

(Source: Yen Press)

216404.description:
Hayato Kobayashi dreams of his high school days, of the soft wind blowing by and the light streaming in through the window onto the beautiful Ritsu Onishi, and of his dazzling smile. Ritsu would sit in the empty library, surrounded by an air of still beauty.

One day, as Hayato's eyes are drawn to Ritsu's soft silhouette under the bright sunlight, Hayato's body moves on its own and places a kiss on Ritsu's lips. Since that day, the two became something more than friends, but not yet boyfriends. The two boys live every day like they're walking on clouds through their vague relationship. It was far too late when Hayato finally realized he was in love. Now as an adult, the two had drifted apart after entering different universities and entering the job market. But who knew that Hayato would one day see that beautiful man of his dreams again...?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

216895.description:
The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

216620.description:
Its Spiritual Realms are bizarre and full of twists. After a mysterious black card turns him into a Night Wandering Deity, protagonist Zhang Yuanqing is pulled into a conspiracy-laden struggle between two rival camps of justice and evil.

(Source: WeTV)

title.native: 死して生きるSSS級ハンター

216624.description:
A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches. Gong-Ja Kim, a weak F-rank Hunter, spends his days envying the Flame Emperor who reigns as the top Hunter. But his chance at greatness finally arrives when he joins forces with the Sword Emperor and gains a rare S-rank skill, with one catch: he must die to activate it.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

216926.description:
Kazu reunites with his childhood friend, Shion, for the first time in a long while. He falls for her all over again as he realizes she’s become even more beautiful, but despite this long-awaited reunion, she seems somehow distant… Shion is harboring a secret Kazu knows nothing about. Though Shion also harbors secret feelings for Kazu, her father, with practiced ease, runs his hands over her sensitive spots and forces her to be “friendly” with him once again today…!

(Source: Getchu, translated)
